design_brief: Hex Lantern — The Witchlight Shrine. A wrought-iron lantern suspended beneath a carved shrine, casting curses upon enemies while strengthening the weapons and spells of nearby defenders. Its identity is a dangerous protective charm, turning a gathered defense into a deadly circle of resistance.
tier1:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original tier-one game tower sprite: HEX LANTERN — THE WITCHLIGHT SHRINE. The only design brief is: A wrought-iron lantern suspended beneath a carved shrine, casting curses upon enemies while strengthening the weapons and spells of nearby defenders. It is a dangerous protective charm, turning a gathered defense into a deadly circle of resistance.
Design this fresh; do not reference any existing tower, prior artwork, character, or familiar franchise.
Subject: a compact ancient carved stone shrine, two broad upright stone jambs supporting a simple peaked heavy stone hood, with ONE large angular wrought-iron lantern hanging visibly by a short chunky chain in the open center. The lantern contains a small controlled violet witchlight formed from flat shapes. A shallow relief notch on the hood suggests a protective charm. A very low cluster of chunky crumbly dark stone grounds the structure. Keep the central hanging lantern unmistakable and the open arch clear.
Ultra-simple dark medieval 2D game illustration: few large angular structural masses, bold BLACK contours and black component separations, two or three broad flat matte planes per material, sparse carving, crisp hard edges, minimal weathering. Somber, dangerous and protective. No filigree, brick pattern, tiny ornament, gradients, glow bloom, floating particles, flying projectiles, people, background scenery, text, labels, UI, checkerboard, floor or cast shadow.
Transparent RGBA background, a SINGLE 1024x1024 square sprite. Straight-on front view; centered core axis x=512. Entire object within x=310..714 and y=325..900, ground contact y=900, lowest rubble at y=900. Core shrine arch approx x=345..679, peaked hood tip at y=325, lantern centered x=512 at y=570. Maintain generous empty margins above and to both sides for later cumulative upgrades. This is a small tier-one structure on a large canvas, do not enlarge it to fill frame.
Strict selected family palette ONLY: #000000 outer contours and deep joints; #171B1A iron deepest shadow; #2A302D iron dark face; #49514A iron edge; #323A33 stone deep shadow; #4D5749 stone main face; #707864 stone upper facets; #968F76 stone sparse worn carving; #433749 lantern violet shadow; #725C80 lantern violet body; #A08BAD lantern violet light; #C6B8C3 tiny lantern light core; #3F594B empowerment branch dark green; #809878 empowerment branch light green; #6B456D curse branch dark mulberry; #AD7B9E curse branch light mulberry. Tier 1 uses only first 12 colors; reserve green and mulberry accent pairs for final branch additions. Shared stone main face #4D5749, shadow #323A33, upper facets #707864 remain constant in every tier. No extra RGB values; no soft shading. True transparent empty background.
tier2:

tier3:

Source canvas is 1254x1254. Center axis x627; ground y1156; original roof peak (627,459). Do not enlarge or rearrange any part.
ADD ONE major structural upgrade ABOVE the roof: a large thick wrought-iron protective ritual hoop with an angular eight-sided outer silhouette and a clear open center. The hoop center should be (627,330), with approximate outer extents x485..769 and y188..472. Attach its bottom firmly behind the existing roof apex using a short broad iron socket. It is forged solid iron with heavy black contours, dark #171B1A shadows, #2A302D broad faces and a few #49514A facets. Put just one small restrained violet wedge inset at the top of the hoop; keep the rest open. This is a physical iron fixture, not a floating aura. It gives the shrine a recognizable circle-of-resistance crown. Keep the original roof carving fully visible and unchanged, with the hoop passing behind it. Keep all additions above y510. No other additions.
Flat two-dimensional dark medieval game illustration, few large readable shapes, two or three flat matte planes, extremely sparse detail. True transparent RGBA background. No gradient, glow, particles, scene, text, checkerboard, shadows or floor.
